== Summary ==
Team standings of the Corona Cup 2020 online team event (1–25 October 2020) at its Final Confrontation, posted by organizer [[Tamás Papp]] on 22 October 2020.

* '''Event:''' [[Tamás Papp]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2020-10-22
